name: runtime-corrector
description: Evidence-bound native review; host execution, output and approvals remain native.

reviewerModel.description: Configured OpenClaw provider/model for reviewers; defaults to the active model.

stopReviewEngine.description: Use isolated single-obligation review for supported completion objects; native preserves the previous reviewer transport.

reviewerTimeoutMs.description: Optional explicit reviewer cap; otherwise project reviewer timeout applies. Does not increase host Hook or parent task budgets.
